questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Babesia spp.?
options: Operculated fluke eggs in a stool wet mount.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
Giardia cysts with four nuclei in a stool preparation.
questions.explanation: Parasites in peripheral blood erythrocytes. Giemsa thin films near 1000× with molecular confirmation; interpret parasitemia through validated laboratory procedures.
